implied.label: PDM15 battery feed (engine PDM)
sources: MoTeC PDM user manual p.43 (PDM15 pinout) connector C = M6 stud Battery +; chapters/17 §17.3 topology, §17.8.4 (6 AWG at the M6 stud)
